### Ongoing exhibitions

### Mart Rovereto

![Gianni Berengo Gardin, "Parigi", 1989 © Eredi Gianni Berengo Gardin - Contrasto ](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/n5rbr3he/2_parigi-1989.jpg?anchor=center&mode=crop&width=640&height=360&rnd=134364460815770000)

### Gianni Berengo Gardin. Worlds to Inhabit

Mart Rovereto | 24 Oct 2026 — 14 Feb 2027

The Mart is dedicating a major exhibition to one of the leading figures in Italian photography, Gianni Berengo Gardin (1930–2025), exploring one of the central aspects of his artistic vision: his architectural sensibility.

[Learn more](/en/mostre/gianni-berengo-gardin-worlds-to-inhabit-162260)

![Adalberto Libera, "Scuole elementari in piazza Raffaello Sanzio a Trento", fotografia, 1934 ca.](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/mcxgzo0s/libera-grande.jpg?center=0.57222096918360355,0.48548708289691944&mode=crop&width=640&height=360&rnd=134365366159370000)

### Group 7 and the birth of Italian Rationalism

Mart Rovereto | 23 Oct 2026 — 17 Jan 2027

In the autumn of 1926, seven young architecture students from the Politecnico di Milano founded Gruppo 7: this was the first attempt to bring to Italy the radical ideas of rationalist architecture, which had been gaining ground in Europe for several years thanks to the writings and designs of architects such as Le Corbusier, Walter Gropius and Peter Behrens.

[Learn more](/en/mostre/group-7-and-the-birth-of-italian-rationalism-160143)

![Alberto Savinio, "Les rois mages", 1929, Mart](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/fonncu4q/31_alberto-savinio_les-rois-mages_1929_mart.jpg?anchor=center&mode=crop&width=640&height=360&rnd=133773678174670000)

### The Collections

Mart, Rovereto

Dedicated to the greatest masterpieces of the museum's collections, the permanent exhibition presents over 400 works organised in fourteen thematic sections: from the 19th century to the Transavantgarde, through Futurism, Metaphysics and the Novecento Italiano, Abstraction, Verbo-Visual Languages and Arte Povera.

[Learn more](/en/mostre/the-collections-138837)

### Casa d'Arte Futurista Depero

![ Casa Depero. Gli Arazzi](https://media.mart.tn.it/media/qzdd4mrv/2-casa-depero-mart-fernando-guerra.jpg?center=0.51518636271392815,0.32384566729917774&mode=crop&width=640&height=360&rnd=132766967855000000)

### Casa Depero

Via dei Portici 38, 38068 Rovereto (TN)

Casa Depero is a ten-minute walk from Mart, in the elegant historic centre of medieval Rovereto. The only museum founded by a Futurist – Depero himself, in 1957 – as an irreverent, visionary project: innovation, irony, and breaking down of all hierarchies in the arts. One floor at a time, you will discover Fortunato Depero's fantastic universe.

[Visit Casa Depero](/en/visita-casa-depero)

### Stones Into Bread

Galleria Civica, Trento | 17 Jul - 15 Nov 2026

Drawing on the ideas of the Italian anthropologist Vito Teti and building on the concepts developed by the Mart at the Galleria Civica in Trento, the exhibition presents a new exploration of fragile, depopulated and abandoned places, with a particular focus on the ‘highlands’.

[Learn more](/en/mostre/stones-into-bread-160120)

### Water Flow Water, Art, Science, Humanity

Palazzo delle Albere, Trento | 10 Oct 2026 — 6 Jun 2027

At the Renaissance Palazzo delle Albere, Mart and MUSE unite their expertise to foster a dynamic dialogue among art, science, and historical heritage in order to investigate natural phenomena, technological processes, and environmental transformations related to water, as part of the European STARTS program (Science, Technology and the Arts).

[Learn more](https://www.mart.tn.it/waterflow)
